title: Image compressor: reduce photo file size
description: Make JPG, PNG and WebP files smaller for websites, email or messengers. See how much you saved — files are never uploaded.

files.paste: You can also paste from the clipboard (Ctrl+V)
files.privacy: Files are processed in your browser and never uploaded.

ui.pngNote: PNG is lossless, and a browser almost never makes it smaller than the original. That's why Auto saves PNG as WebP — much lighter, and transparency is kept.
